text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"'Running all this way, I've seen so many 
sights. 
And among those sights, "that girl" was 
always there—'"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"'Be it like the sun, or like fireworks... 
In any case, so powerful! And with such a 
blinding brightness!'"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Haaahhh... Great curse, ultimate bad 
luck~~~~~~..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Gods above, Buddhas, Lady Shiraoki~~!! 
Please grant me good fortune! 
Please grant me victoryyy!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"......Will I... even be able to win, I 
wonder... 
Wait, gyawaaahhh?!?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Fukukitaru! Fancy meeting you here, it 
must be destiny! 
I was looking for a partner to train with, 
so please join me!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Ehh?! N-No, today is a bit...?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! You look kinda down in the dumps, 
Fukukitaru! 
Times like this, running with all your 
might is the best medicine!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"(Wh-What incredible vitality... It's like 
she has a halo around her...! 
She's like a running good omen...!)"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "(...... A good omen—)"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"(...If. If I can just keep up with this 
shining back... 
Will good luck return to me as well...?)"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Fukukitaru! Your pace is picking up! 
But the real show starts now!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Haaaahhhh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"'...Yes. It truly was a good omen. 
I just ran and ran... and before I knew 
it, all my worries had vanished,'"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"'And from there... my Great Blessing 
waterfall climb began!'"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"'Whenever I wanted to change something, 
reach for something... 
And took a bold leap of faith—'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "...Suuu~zuuu~kaaa~~...!!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Taiki? 
Why are you here?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka, you're leaving for Hong Kong, 
right?! Thinking about that 
made me feel so lonely... so I ran all the 
way from the academy to see you off!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"F-From the academy?! It's not like I'll 
be staying there for long, 
you didn't need to go that far..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, it's great that I made it in 
time! I'm cheering for you, Suzuka! 
I'll send tons of LANE messages too! So—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Have fun over there! 
Go see lots of sights you've never seen 
before, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"............ You're right. Sights I've 
never seen before... 
I should enjoy every bit of them..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"'Unseen sights. That is... something I 
want to keep seeking, 
forever and ever. ...However. More than 
anything, the sight I want to see is—'"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"'Beyond the ultimate speed—the scenery at 
the lead.'"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"'She's a mysterious girl, isn't she? 
Without even realizing it herself... 
She gives everyone around her a reason to 
run, a reason to keep going.'"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"'...Now is the time to say thank you. For 
being there. 
For being a comrade who runs in the same 
era!'"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"'To Taiki, who has always clashed with us 
with everything she has— 
We will give everything we have in 
return!'"

text_block_list.name: Show Viewers
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...!" "It's finally starting, the 
final episode!" 
"Just what are they gonna show us—" 
"Ngh!?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, everyone. First, let us thank 
you 
for watching this program all the way to 
its finale.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, we've supported you with 
confectionery methods, 
wrapping tips, and ways to express your 
feelings, but—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, what we truly needed to 
convey first... 
We have—at last—realized what that is.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—conveying one's feelings— 
is in the end—

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Earth
text_block_list.text: A BATTLE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. In the end, we just wanted 
something convincing. 
To simply follow an existing recipe, hand 
it over, and call it a day...?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Valentine's Day is... no mere game. 
It is a festival where one dedicates their 
most precious feelings."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"What will now take place is a battle—a 
serious, all-out brawl 
where we clash our confections, infused 
with all our heartfelt feelings."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The rules are simple... Whosoever slams 
their stronger 'feelings' 
into the opponent's stomach and heart 
shall claim victory. That is all—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Strong feelings have the power to knock 
out an opponent! 
We shall prove that today!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Tonight. We shall clash our confections, 
packed with all our heartfelt devotion.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"May that will, that fervor, that wave 
become a rhythm pushing you forward... 
and elevate into a symphony where all 
people share their feelings."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Now—let the battle begin!! 
First up is Fukukitaru's team!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Now... here we go, everyone! 
We shall convey our deepest feelings to 
Taiki-san and Earth-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Swiftly cut the ingredients, combine, 
apply heat, 
and bring out the flavor to its absolute 
maximum!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Like the stars that adorn the 'Milky 
Way'— 
brilliantly 'decorate'."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"And what it leads to is— 
the Bermuda Triangle of Deliciousness!! 
Behold—its advent!"

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Galactic Gâteau Lucky Chocolat!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"T-The things sitting atop this big 
cake... 
Are those cookies shaped like us!?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. ...In the end, having Taiki and 
everyone here made our 'past' possible... 
and we want our 'future' to continue 
together too."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The three of us 'combined' those 
feelings—into our 'Ultimate Move'.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's not just about 
appearances! 
Please, taste it for yourselves!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Earth
text_block_list.text: I-It's so deliiiiicious!!!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"A-And this hint of cinnamon... It tastes 
just like 
Mom's homemade cake!? Suzuka, did you guys 
remember what I said before...!?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Moreover, this organic flavor... 
Did you use soy milk as a secret 
ingredient!?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Kh, the sense required to bring such 
complex flavors together, not to mention 
the presentation! 
This is no ordinary feat... Just who 
designed this recipe...!?"

text_block_list.name: Carefree Student
text_block_list.text:
"W-What does this mean!? Honestly, 
throughout this whole show, 
I never sensed any culinary talent from 
them at all...?"

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, a senior once 
made an ehomaki for me. 
An authentic one, starting with homemade 
dried gourd strips. And that senior was—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my gosh...! 
I totally forgot about that...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Out of the five of us... Fukukitaru-san—

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Earth
text_block_list.text:
Is the one who can actually cook 
normally!?!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hehehe... My specialty is traditional 
Japanese cuisine, but— 
by the way, I've also baked canelés 
before!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Earth
text_block_list.text:
"GUAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!" 
"Gwaaaahhhhh!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"(Hehehe... Heartfelt devotion. It's not 
about 'what you give', 
but 'how much feeling you pour into it'... 
That is the true essence!)"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"We poured everything we had into this! 
Now... how will the two of you receive 
it!?"
